reports.title: Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT) Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Financial Guidance
section: The Company is raising its full-year 2026 organic constant currency revenue growth guidance to the range of 9.1% to 9.7%. Including the effect of currency translation, full-year 2026 organic reported revenue is expected to be in the range of $3.429 billion to $3.447 billion.
The Company is raising its acquired business revenue expectation and now expects full-year 2026 acquired business reported revenue of approximately $3.050 billion on an owned-period basis.
Total Company reported revenue for full-year 2026 is expected to be in the range of $6.479 billion to $6.497 billion.

The Company is updating its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to the range of $14.60 to $14.70, which represents 11% to 12% year-over-year adjusted EPS growth and is 13% to 14% on a constant currency basis.

The Company expects fourth quarter 2026 organic constant currency revenue growth to be in the range of 7.0% to 9.0%. Including the effect of currency translation, fourth quarter 2026 organic reported revenue is expected to be in the range of $984 million to $1.002 billion.
The Company expects acquired business reported revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 to be approximately $817 million.
Total Company reported revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to be in the range of $1.801 billion to $1.819 billion.
The Company expects fourth quarter 2026 adjusted EPS to be in the range of $4.58 to $4.68, which represents 1% to 3% year-over-year adjusted EPS growth.
